exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar; grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Unrack and lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Press back up to lockout, keeping feet planted and upper back tight.

exercises.name: Back Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and step out of the rack.
Bend hips and knees together, sitting down until thighs pass parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand, keeping the bar over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms fully extended.
Curl both weights toward your shoulders without swinging your elbows.
Lower under control back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Sit and grip the bar wider than shoulder width, thighs braced under the pads.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise under control until your arms are extended.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
instructions: Hold a kettlebell vertically at your chest with both hands.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up and elbows inside your knees.
Drive back up to standing.

exercises.name: Push Up
instructions: Set your hands slightly wider than shoulder width in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body in a straight line.
Press back up to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, arms out for balance.
Bend hips and knees to squat down until thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up to full hip extension.

exercises.name: Pull Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, wider than shoulder width.
Pull your chin above the bar, driving your elbows down toward your hips.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: Chin Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull your chin above the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: Dips
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders dip below them.
Press back up to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Handstand Push Up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall, hands shoulder width apart.
Lower your head toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up to a full handstand.

exercises.name: Pull Up (Weighted)
instructions: Attach a weight plate to a dip belt and hang from a pull-up bar.
Pull your chin above the bar, driving your elbows down toward your hips.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: Push Up (Weighted)
instructions: Have a partner place a weight plate across your upper back in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body straight.
Press back up to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Pull Up (Assisted)
instructions: Kneel on the assisted pull-up machine's platform and grip the bar overhand.
Pull your chin above the bar using the counterweight assistance.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Support yourself on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Hold a straight line from head to heels without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean against a wall and slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold the position with your knees over your ankles.

exercises.name: Running
instructions: Run at a steady pace, landing under your hips with a relaxed upper body.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with your legs first, then lean back and pull the handle to your ribs.
Reverse the sequence to return to the catch position.

exercises.name: Farmers Walk (Dumbbell)
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Walk forward with short, controlled steps, keeping your shoulders back.

exercises.name: Stair Machine (Floors)
instructions: Step continuously on the stair machine at a steady pace.
Keep your torso upright rather than leaning on the handrails.

exercises.name: Stair Machine (Steps)
instructions: Step continuously on the stair machine at a steady pace.
Keep your torso upright rather than leaning on the handrails.
